content.short: Gamer NFT Network is a Chainlink-backed gaming ecosystem on Cardano featuring a marketplace and P2E tools.
content.description: Gamer NFT Network is a comprehensive gaming ecosystem built on the Cardano blockchain, designed to bridge the gap between traditional gaming and Web3. Backed by Chainlink oracles, the platform provides developers with an SDK and NFT builder to easily integrate blockchain features into their games. For players, it offers a robust marketplace for trading in-game items, a streaming platform, and a tournament manager for competitive events. By prioritizing scalability and user experience, Gamer NFT Network empowers a global community to monetize their gaming passion and digital assets.
